name: mobile_login_to_cloud_provider
description: Start authenticating this machine with the remote device cloud provider. This is required once before mobile_list_remote_devices or mobile_allocate_remote_device will work; if either of those fails with an authentication error, call this tool and then retry. This starts a browser-based device-code login and returns quickly with a URL and a one-time code - it does NOT wait for the login to complete. Show the URL and code to the user verbatim and ask them to open the URL and enter the code in their own browser. The login keeps running in the background after this tool returns; once the user confirms they've completed it, retry the remote devices tool that originally failed. Only call this after the user has explicitly asked to connect to, log into, or use remote/cloud devices - never call it speculatively, since it interrupts the user to act in their browser.
